Thursday Sep 24 had closed at 170,499, DOWN 1,734pts (-1.01%) with 358 decliners vs 101 gainers (The Nation). Week: -0.07%. Drawdown from the Jan 23 ATH 9.91% — AMBER vs the 10% trigger (prepare, not act); the 2.5% daily-move trigger is quiet. MACRO (as of Sep 25): SBP policy rate 11.5%, held on Sep 14 for a 4th straight meeting on oil/Middle-East inflation risk; August CPI 11.1% YoY (from 9.2% in July), so the real policy rate is about zero and equities must earn well above ~11.5-12% to beat risk-free. T-bills (latest early-Sep auction): 3m 11.60%, 6m 11.90%, 12m 11.99%. PKR steady at ~277.2-277.6/USD interbank on Sep 25 (Business Recorder/Pakistan Times); SBP FX reserves ~.4bn after the September Eurobond. Petrol Rs 384.34/l after the Sep 16 hike. IMF: fourth EFF + third RSF review talks opened with SBP in Karachi on Sep 23; the mission moves to Islamabad (Finance Ministry/FBR) on Sep 28; a staff-level agreement would unlock ~ EFF + ~ RSF — mild event risk until it lands. HOLDINGS NEWS (as of Sep 25): Searle FY26 results filed Sep 25 (see action). AIRLINK filed a '29th Board Meeting' notice Sep 22 (agenda/date unverified — likely FY26 results). UPFL filed a Q3 board-meeting/closed-period notice Sep 24. The former Fauji Foods CEO has joined FrieslandCampina Engro as CEO; no FFL successor yet. EFERT was the only urea maker to grow sales in August (+18% YoY). Confirmed ex-dividend dates (BSL ex-dates list, as of Sep 23): NATF Oct 16, MUGHAL Oct 19, GHGL Oct 21. DATA QUALITY: prices.json stock prices have been frozen since the Sep 23 midday update (commits since then change only the timestamp) — this review uses Sep 25 PSX Data Portal closing quotes instead; fund NAVs frozen at Aug 13 (43 days stale) — a scraper fix exists but is not yet deployed.

Keep the position small; take profits if it runs 50%+; re-assess once the successor is named.

In plain words: a good company, priced fairly for its steady earnings, not cheap because of the one-off.

actions.title: Searle — FY26 out: better business, tax ate the profit
actions.detail: FY26 results filed Sep 25 (figures per Bloom Pakistan/Topline, Sep 25 — the PSX filing PDF wasn't machine-readable, so treat as unverified against the filing): sales Rs 36.8bn (+29%), gross margin 52% vs 49%, finance cost halved (-48%) — the business genuinely improved. But the effective tax rate jumped to ~87% (from 47%), so full-year profit was only Rs 440M (EPS Rs 0.75), and Q4 was a consolidated loss of ~Rs 1.8bn (-Rs 3.14/share). A ~Rs 3.7bn one-off gain from moving its biologicals brands into a subsidiary flatters the standalone accounts only. First dividend in five years: Rs 1/share (ex-date not yet announced). In plain words: the shop is selling more at better margins and owes less interest, but the tax bill ate almost everything this year — pricey on this year's profit (portal P/E ~18), fair if the tax hit is one-off (Topline FY27E P/E ~10.6x, BUY). Rs 82.43 Sep 25 close (-0.6% on cost), right at its ~82 entry. Hold; don't add more until the FY27 Q1 result shows the tax rate normalising. DRAP pricing review: unverified since Sep 19.
actions.target: Hold; re-check at Q1 FY27 (tax rate back toward normal = thesis on track; another near-zero year = downgrade to WATCH)

entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 off the Jan ATH). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.

MZNPETF.note: Broad Islamic index ETF — your #1 DCA vehicle. Accumulate on any dip; entry is just under fair value, add = deeper monthly support.

MIIETF.note: Second index-ETF leg. Same DCA logic — buy small and often, more at the add level.

MEBL.note: Core compounder but ran up (~544). Start adding on a pullback to ~540; back up the truck at/below Rs 500 (the standing allocation line).

MIF.note: Actively managed Islamic equity fund (NAV-based). Accumulate on monthly dips.

NATF.note: Consumer-staple compounder. Rarely cheap — accumulate patiently on dips to ~355, more near 335.

FATIMA.note: Strong H1 (profit +20.7%), concessionary-gas edge. Add on a pullback to ~147; watch the dividend-skip question.

BWCL.note: Cement upcycle, dividend payer, Q3 profit +12% but on softer operating margins. Accumulate near monthly support ~460, more at 435.

GLAXO.note: Defensive pharma with pricing-deregulation tailwind. Add on dips to ~322.

SEARL.note: Pharma margin recovery underway. Accumulate near ~82 — today's price sits inside the zone.

CPHL.note: Fundamentals intact, just re-rating (-13% on cost). Fair add zone ~71 — today's price is right around it.

GHGL.note: Solid industrial, +18% on cost. Add on a dip to ~39.

MUGHAL.note: Steel cyclical — NOT a forever hold. Only add near cycle-support ~73; be ready to trim on a doubling.

DCR.note: REIT — income play with steady rental dividends. Add for yield near ~38; inflation hedge.

EFERT.note: INCOME, not growth (WATCH). Only add for the yield near ~174; urea glut keeps upside capped — don't overweight.

AIRLINK.note: HIGH BETA, policy-dependent — cap the position. Only small adds near ~125; trim on sharp rallies.

FFL.note: Turnaround, KEEP SMALL. Tiny adds only near ~14.5; take profits if it runs 50%+.

AVN.note: NOT a buy. H1 FY26 swung to a net loss (EPS -0.62); the thesis is broken. This is an exit candidate, not an accumulation — do not average down.

UPFL.note: Only 3 shares (~Rs 74K), illiquid. Exceptional company but immaterial to portfolio decisions — no accumulation plan.
